title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: A birdbath is designed to overflow so that it will be self-cleaning. Water flows in at the rate of \(20\) milliliters per minute and drains at the rate of \(18\) milliliters per minute. One of these graphs shows the volume of water in the birdbath during the filling time and continuing into the overflow time. Which one is it?

solutions.text:
Before the birdbath overflows, it gains \(20-18=2\) milliliters of water per minute, so its volume increases steadily.

Once the birdbath is full, the incoming extra water overflows, so the volume remains constant. Only graph A shows an increasing line followed by a horizontal line.

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Before overflow, the volume rises at a constant positive rate.
After the birdbath is full, extra water overflows so the volume stays constant.
